title: Jerome on Malachi 1:1
body: “Malachi, the last of all the prophets, speaks openly of the rejection of Israel and the calling of the nations.”
author: Jerome, Letter 53, to Paulinus

title: John Chrysostom on Malachi 1:14
body: “I have often said and I say now also: the greatness of the charity is not shown by the measure of what is given, but by the disposition of the giver. You know the case of the widow.”
author: John Chrysostom, Homilies on John and Hebrews

title: John Chrysostom on Malachi 3:1
body: “Having in the introduction spoken to us things of urgent importance concerning God the Word, (the Evangelist) proceeding on his road, and in order, afterwards comes to the herald of the Word, his namesake John. And now that thou hearest that he was "sent from God," do not for the future imagine that any of the words spoken by him are mere man's words; for all that he utters is not his own, but is of Him who sent him.”
author: John Chrysostom, Homilies on John and Hebrews

title: John Chrysostom on Malachi 4:1
body: “Perhaps some are even disgusted and laugh. For this very cause ought we to make our lamentations the more intense, because we are so mad and beside ourselves, that we do not know that we are mad, but laugh at things for which we ought to groan.”
author: John Chrysostom, Homilies on John and Hebrews
